The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives this week deployed 29 inspectors to the mill, which is home to the largest cluster of federally licensed gun vendors at a single address in the nation. Ten of the inspectors came from ATF’s “Major Inspection Team,” a group of senior agents from across the country.
